corrected_findings.evidence: Target areas are now 16, 12, 15, and 20 across rich residues 1, 3, 5, and 7. Area 12 is also a distractor in residue 1. The declared area-12 rival has three refutations in each eight-sample cyclic window.
Source uses type(index) is int and a nonnegative guard. The probe rejects True, False, 0.0, 1.5, and string 1 with TypeError, and -1 with ValueError.

Source has distinct rich dimensions: easy height 17..18 and width 6..8; medium height 18..19 and width 7..10; hard height 19..20 and width 9..12. The bounded seed-7 probe observes differing dimensions in all bands.
Four even core slots per period of eight all generate legal canonical-like linked profiles. The bounded 16-pair probe reports 50% strict fraction for each band.

The test is renamed test_pixel_count_and_area_ranks_are_not_identical. The latest docstring says varied object ranks rather than independently ranked. The relationship remains area_rank = 2 - count_rank for rich scenes; the renamed test accurately establishes nonidentity.

additional_findings.finding: A natural color-blind rival choosing the most elongated bounding box fits all three canonical pairs, is refuted only at rich residue 1, and therefore fits all seven demos but disagrees when residue 1 is the query. This lies outside the 17 declared rivals. It does not mean the declared checks failed or that all possible hypotheses can be covered.
additional_findings.static_evidence: Target aspect ratios at residues 1/3/5/7 equal 1, 4/3, 5/3, and 5/4. Distractor ratios equal {1,4/3}, {1,1}, {1,5/4}, and {1,1}; hence the target maximizes aspect ratio except at residue 1.
additional_findings.rival_definition: Compute Fraction(max(bbox height, bbox width), min(...)); select the maximum, breaking ties by scan origin and color; fill the selected bounding box with 6 and erase everything else.

PYTHONPATH=shared/runtime python3 - <<'PY'
from reviewer_support import load_selected_generator, canonical_pairs
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
G,source,sha=load_selected_generator('f9cd85012aa8',root=Path.cwd())
assert sha=='77cf53c6fe0e28be5e106019568ecf4513e64568c83a95730de6df43776b095f'
canon=canonical_pairs(G.TASK_ID,root=Path.cwd(),labeled_only=True)
assert all(fn(p['input'])==p['output'] for fn in G.CANONICAL_SHORTCUTS.values() for p in canon)
rows=[]
for band in ['easy','medium','hard']:
    pairs=[]
    for i in range(16):
        grid=G.generate(7,i,difficulty=band)
        assert not G.self_check(grid)
        assert grid==G.generate(7,i,difficulty=band)
        pairs.append({'input':grid,'output':G._box_output(grid,G._target_cells(grid))})
    mins={name:min(sum(fn(p['input'])!=p['output'] for p in pairs[start:start+8]) for start in range(8)) for name,fn in G.CANONICAL_SHORTCUTS.items()}
    assert min(mins.values())>=2
    for start in range(8):
        window=pairs[start:start+8]
        for qi,q in enumerate(window):
            assert G.lesson_identifiable([p for j,p in enumerate(window) if j!=qi],q)==[]
    areas=[]
    for i in [1,3,5,7]:
        grid=pairs[i]['input']
        parts=G._components(grid)
        areas.append({'residue':i,'target_area':next(G._bbox(cells)[0]*G._bbox(cells)[1] for col,cells in parts if col==6),'distractor_areas':sorted(G._bbox(cells)[0]*G._bbox(cells)[1] for col,cells in parts if col!=6)})
    rows.append({'band':band,'pairs':len(pairs),'strict_fraction':sum(not G.strict_canonical_like(p['input']) for p in pairs)/len(pairs),'rich_dimensions':[(len(pairs[i]['input']),len(pairs[i]['input'][0])) for i in [1,3,5,7]],'min_rival_refutations':mins,'areas':areas})
rejected=[]
for index in [True,False,0.0,1.5,'1',-1]:
    try:G.generate(7,index)
    except (ValueError,TypeError) as e:rejected.append({'repr':repr(index),'exception':type(e).__name__})
    else:raise AssertionError(index)
print(json.dumps({'generator_sha256':sha,'canonical_pairs':len(canon),'rivals':len(G.CANONICAL_SHORTCUTS),'schedule_period':G.LESSON_SCHEDULE_PERIOD,'demos':G.EXAMPLES_NEEDED,'rows':rows,'rejected_indices':rejected}))

actual_commands.command:
PYTHONPATH=shared/runtime python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction
from reviewer_support import load_selected_generator,canonical_pairs
import json
G,source,sha=load_selected_generator('f9cd85012aa8',root=Path.cwd())
def elongated(grid):
    parts=G._components(grid)
    def key(part):
        h,w=G._bbox(part[1])
        return Fraction(max(h,w),min(h,w)),min(part[1]),part[0]
    return G._box_output(grid,max(parts,key=key)[1])
canon=canonical_pairs(G.TASK_ID,root=Path.cwd(),labeled_only=True)
assert all(elongated(p['input'])==p['output'] for p in canon)
pairs=[]
for i in range(8):
    grid=G.generate(7,i,difficulty='medium')
    pairs.append({'input':grid,'output':G._box_output(grid,G._target_cells(grid))})
refuting=[i for i,p in enumerate(pairs) if elongated(p['input'])!=p['output']]
print(json.dumps({'sha256':sha,'canonical_fits':len(canon),'refuting_indices':refuting,'query_index':1,'all_seven_demos_fit':all(elongated(p['input'])==p['output'] for i,p in enumerate(pairs) if i!=1),'query_disagrees':elongated(pairs[1]['input'])!=pairs[1]['output'],'domain_errors':G.self_check(pairs[1]['input'])}))
PY
